svg.aria-label: Four-chapter technical roadmap of the CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) series
svg.text: CLIP Architecture & Multimodal Contrastive Learning — Technical Roadmap
From Radford et al. (2021) data-efficiency scaling and Figure 3 pseudocode to ResNet/ViT towers, Zero-Shot Prompting, and SigLIP
CHAPTER 01
Why Contrastive Beats Captioning (12× Efficiency)
• Exact word-by-word LM captioning (1×) vs. Bag-of-Words (3×)
• Contrastive pretraining (12× faster zero-shot ImageNet scaling)
• WIT-400M dataset & the N × N cosine similarity matrix
Diagonal positives (I_i · T_i) vs. N(N − 1) off-diagonal negatives
CHAPTER 02
Figure 3 Pseudocode & Symmetric InfoNCE
• Linear projections W_i[d_i, d_e] & W_t[d_t, d_e] into shared space
• Why L2 normalization onto S^(d_e−1) prevents norm explosion
• Learnable log-temperature exp(t) ≤ 100 & labels = np.arange(n)
loss = (CE(logits, labels, axis=0) + CE(logits, labels, axis=1)) / 2
CHAPTER 03
Vision & Text Encoders: ResNet-D, ViT & BPE
• Modified ResNet-D stem + anti-aliased blur + AttentionPool2d
• Vision Transformer (ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14@336px) with extra ln_pre
• 12-layer causal BPE Text Transformer pooled at [EOS] token
AttentionPool2d(q = mean(HW), K = HW + pos) vs. ViT [CLS]
CHAPTER 04
Zero-Shot Prompts, Modality Gap & SigLIP
• Synthesizing zero-shot linear heads from "A photo of a {label}"
• 80-prompt ensembling (+3.5% ImageNet) at zero extra test FLOPs
• The Modality Gap cone geometry & SigLIP pairwise sigmoid loss
L_SigLIP = −(1/N²) Σ_ij log σ(z_ij · (t · I_i^T T_j + b))
